evidence_scope.generation_constraint: Generation receives exactly one source_reference image and self-contained prompt text.

medium_rendering.transferable_rule: Render source-controlled content as a polished editorial anime poster with opaque cel-shaded planes and crisp print separation, not photorealism or 3D.
prompt_clauses: polished editorial anime poster illustration
crisp opaque two-to-three-step cel-shaded planes
screen-print-like color separation with precise deep-navy ink

observations: Saturated teal, coral, and warm-yellow support colors
Value-group contrast instead of photographic gradients
palette_tone.transferable_rule: Use a limited warm-paper, navy, teal, coral, warm-yellow, and muted-gold print relationship while preserving literal source color identity through source-relative semantic-region treatment.
prompt_clauses: limited warm-paper, deep-navy, teal, coral, warm-yellow, and restrained muted-gold poster-print relationship
preserve source color identity and translate only relative value grouping, cel shadows, highlights, contours, and print-facet behavior

observed_relative_behavior.value: luminous light plane with a restrained darker warm band
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: subdued relative warmth against saturated supports
observed_relative_behavior.shading: clean cel shadow plus a narrow highlight

skin.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source skin identity; translate only relative light, shadow, highlight, and contour grouping into graphic cel-shaded planes.
prompt_clauses: render visible skin as source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and narrow highlight planes with selective deep-navy contour
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity

observed_relative_behavior.chroma: restrained cool teal/cyan and warm coral accents
observed_relative_behavior.shading: separated value blocks and sparse rim or strand planes

hair.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity while grouping values into a coherent mass with restrained relative accent planes.
prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accent planes and tapered navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: interlocking dark, light, and accent facets
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: limited harmonizing teal, coral, yellow, and gold relationships

clothing.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Keep every source garment silhouette, construction detail, marking, logo, and literal color identity intact; add only restrained source-relative print facets that follow existing folds and seams.
prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain its silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accent edges, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos

observations: Adaptable discs, panels, rules, brush sweeps, dots, arcs, and connectors
line_shape.transferable_rule: Use decisive variable-weight deep-navy ink, sparse tapered detail, and adaptable abstract support vocabulary without copying literal teacher geometry.
prompt_clauses: decisive variable-weight deep-navy ink contours resolving into sparse tapered fine strokes
adaptable abstract discs, blocks, rules, brush sweeps, arcs, dots, and connectors without copied geometry

texture_material.transferable_rule: Add light tactile poster-print texture that preserves source legibility and avoids literal mark trajectories.
prompt_clauses: visible warm paper grain with restrained screen-print speckling, imperfect overprint edges, sparse paint flecks, and occasional dry-brush interruptions
keep texture away from important source details and legible markings

observations: Broad opaque support fields precede focal content
Sparse fine gold line and dot ornament completes the hierarchy
graphic_language.transferable_rule: Use adaptable asymmetric poster hierarchy and negative-space rhythm around source-controlled content; lettering is conditional on exact caller text.
prompt_clauses: place broad opaque abstract support fields behind or around source-controlled content, then add sparse fine muted-gold orbital lines, dots, and connectors
retain adaptable negative-space rhythm without copying layout or placement

typography_dialogue.activation: Only when optional text is supplied; otherwise render no text.
typography_dialogue.medium: High-contrast editorial display ink integrated with the poster-print surface.
typography_dialogue.stroke: Elegant readable calligraphic/display-like primary stroke with crisp edges and restrained fine detail.
typography_dialogue.hierarchy: Caller-supplied exact text is the only lettering content and is one restrained display accent.
typography_dialogue.orientation: Adapt for readability; no fixed teacher angle.
typography_dialogue.placement_grammar: Use unused negative space or a suitable support field without covering important source content or copying teacher placement.
typography_dialogue.ornament: Sparse fine dot/line ornament may frame supplied text without adding words.
prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
use a readable high-contrast editorial display ink with elegant calligraphic/display-like strokes, adaptive orientation, open-space placement, and sparse dot/line ornament
do not copy teacher wording, script, language, logo, or text placement
